problems: first-toungoo-empire, konbaung-dynasty, shan-states pairs: lan-xang carries losses to first-toungoo-empire in 1574-12 and 1579-10 and a gain in 1591; kingdom-of-mrauk-u carries Toungoo occupations of Thandwe (1546-47, 1580-81) and its own occupations of Syriam and Pegu (1599-1603); Cliopatria's Toungoo shape of 1579-1587 contains all of Lan Xang and its 1547-1551 shape contains 158 Arakan cells that mrauk-u marks wrong, and its Konbaung shape takes Arakan only in 1788 (the pages say 2 January 1785): the Toungoo and Konbaung dossiers should pair or correct these
ava-kingdom ends in March 1527 (the shan-states dossier already draws Ava as Shan from 1527); Wikipedia runs Ava to 22 January 1555 under Shan-appointed kings
le-dynasty ends in 1571 because Cliopatria hands the land to the Trinh and Nguyen lords from 1572; the Le dynasty itself runs to 1789
